end.summary:
Asha practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya answered 6 identification questions, with 3 unaided correct responses.
They identified cube faces and cylinder flat faces, and named a ball as a sphere.
They first called a matchbox a cube, then checked the faces and changed it to cuboid.
Teach-back was not passed; the box-shape mix-up was corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solid shapes using familiar objects and checking features such as faces and flat surfaces. Aditya explained that a cube has six faces, identified a cylinder in a candle, and used the shape of a ball to name a sphere. They initially called a matchbox a cube, then noticed that it was longer and its faces were not equal, so they corrected it to cuboid. At home, please sort a few objects into cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere, asking Aditya to explain which features helped.
